title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct relationship between the masses and volumes of the Earth and Moon.

title: Gravitational Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the gravitational force equation to derive the relationship between orbital radius and mass.

title: Density Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student must articulate that the same orbital period implies equal density for the Earth and Moon.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as sign errors or incorrect assumptions about the masses or radii.
